tagline: 理光数码相机，2007 年发布
description: 理光于2007年推出的数码相机。配备Focal length 5.9 mm (equivalent to 28 mm for 135 film cameras), 6 elements in 5 groups (two aspherical lenses/three aspherical surfaces)。快门速度80, 120, 60, 30, 15, 8, 4, 2, 1 to 1/2000 sec.。感光度Auto, Auto-hi, 80, 100, 200, 400, 800, 1600。Multi-AF (CCD method), Spot-AF (CCD method), manual focus, snap, infinity (focus lock and AF auxiliary light also available)。

specs.镜头: Focal length 5.9 mm (equivalent to 28 mm for 135 film cameras), 6 elements in 5 groups (two aspherical lenses/three aspherical surfaces)
specs.光圈: f/2.4 to f/11 (+f/7.1 in auto mode is with ND filter)
specs.对焦: Multi-AF (CCD method), Spot-AF (CCD method), manual focus, snap, infinity (focus lock and AF auxiliary light also available)
specs.尺寸: 107.0 x 58.0 x 25.0 mm (W x H x D); does not include protruding parts
specs.重量: Approx. 168 g (excluding battery, SD Memory Card, hand strap)
specs.英文简介: The Ricoh GR Digital II was introduced by Ricoh in 2007.
